meta.description: Registry of algorithms and the explanation levels generated for each. Maintained by the learn-an-algorithm skill.
meta.folder_note: Folder is the algorithm's full human-readable name (not the slug). Only the .md filename uses the slug. If a name contains '/', render that slash as ' - ' in the folder name since '/' is a path separator.
meta.slug_rule: lowercase; strip accents (é->e, –->-); replace any run of spaces/slashes/punctuation with a single hyphen; collapse repeated hyphens; trim leading/trailing hyphens

1.contains: One analogy, zero jargon, the core idea in 1-2 sentences

2.contains: Analogy + plain walk-through + why we care

3.contains: Concrete worked mini-example, numbered steps, intuition for how it works

4.contains: Precise statement, pseudocode, Big-O time/space, correctness intuition, mermaid flow

5.contains: Formal definitions, proofs/bounds, design paradigm, edge cases, optimizations, detailed mermaid + pseudocode

6.contains: SOTA variants, theoretical frontiers, open problems, references, links to related problems
